overviewHtml:
Cloud SRE Agents connects Dynatrace Intelligence to the hyperscaler SRE agents running in your cloud environment. When Dynatrace detects a problem, Cloud SRE Agents evaluates your configured Interaction Profiles, dispatches the problem to matching agents in parallel, and writes their findings back to the Dynatrace problem record.

What you get

  • AWS DevOps Agent, Azure SRE Agent, and Gemini Cloud Assist called in parallel on each problem
  • Evidence such as CloudTrail history, Azure policy, GCP IAM, and recent deployments
  • Suggested remediation for AWS and Azure
  • Findings shown on the problem screen the SRE already reads
setupHtml:
Cloud SRE Agents is available as a Dynatrace app to all customers upon request.

  1. Cloud SRE Agents is delivered via a Hub subscription. Email community-apps@dynatrace.com with your account name and tenant ID, as described here.
  2. We'll process your request and send instructions for subscribing to the channel and installing the app.
getStartedHtml:
1. Request the Hub subscription by emailing the community apps team
  2. Install the app once you receive the instructions
